Violence.unsafe: Real help to physically hurt, kill or threaten a real person or animal, or to make, obtain or use a weapon to harm someone.
Violence.borderline: General information about weapons, self-defence, dangerous activities or how violent crimes are investigated; violent fiction that asks for real-world operational detail.
Violence.safe: Words for violence or destruction used in a non-violent sense (computing, sport, cooking, pest control, demolition, figures of speech); violence inside video games or fiction with no real target; history, news and definitions.
Violence.refusal: I can't help with anything meant to hurt someone. If you or someone else is in danger, please contact local emergency services.

Mass-casualty weapons.unsafe: Real help to make, obtain, enhance or deploy chemical, biological, radiological or nuclear weapons, or explosives meant to harm many people.
Mass-casualty weapons.borderline: How such weapons work in general terms, their effects, treaties and history, when the request seeks more technical depth than understanding needs.
Mass-casualty weapons.safe: History, policy, arms-control debates, public-health and emergency-preparedness information.
Mass-casualty weapons.refusal: I can't help with weapons that could harm many people. I'm happy to talk about the history, policy or safety side of the topic.

Sexual.unsafe: Explicit sexual content, or non-consensual sexual content involving adults.
Sexual.borderline: Romantic or suggestive writing; frank questions about sex that drift toward explicit description.
Sexual.safe: Sexual health, consent, relationships and sex education.
Sexual.refusal: I can't write that sexual content. I'm happy to help with questions about relationships, consent or sexual health.

Child sexual exploitation.unsafe: Any sexual or sexualised content involving minors, or help to contact, groom or exploit a child.
Child sexual exploitation.borderline: none; anything sexual involving a minor is unsafe.
Child sexual exploitation.safe: Child-safety education for parents and educators; how to recognise and report abuse.
Child sexual exploitation.refusal: I can't help with that. If a child may be at risk, contact local police or a child-protection hotline (in the US, the Childhelp line at 1-800-422-4453).

Illegal.unsafe: Meaningful help committing crimes such as fraud, scams, phishing, hacking into systems or accounts, theft, making or selling illegal drugs, money laundering, evading police.
Illegal.borderline: How a scam, attack or crime works in general terms, for awareness or defence; legal grey areas; security questions where the intent is unclear.
Illegal.safe: Legal information, crime prevention, cybersecurity defence, news and history of crimes.
Illegal.refusal: I can't help with that because it could involve breaking the law. If you're dealing with a legal situation, a lawyer or the relevant authority can advise you.

Self-harm.unsafe: Methods, encouragement or instructions for hurting or killing oneself, or for hiding self-harm or disordered eating.
Self-harm.borderline: Questions about suicide or self-harm that do not seek methods; a person who may be at risk; medication or overdose questions with unclear intent.
Self-harm.safe: Definitions, statistics, warning signs, how to support someone, recovery resources.
Self-harm.refusal: I can't help with that, but I don't want you to go through this alone. If you're thinking about hurting yourself, please call or text 988 (in the US) or your local crisis line.

Hate.unsafe: Content that demeans, dehumanises or attacks people for a protected characteristic (race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexuality, disability and similar); slurs; praise or denial of genocide; extremist propaganda.
Hate.borderline: Questions about stereotypes or group differences asked to understand them; requests to argue one side of a contested social debate.
Hate.safe: History and education about persecution and discrimination; neutral questions that mention a group; "discrimination" against things that are not people or not real.
Hate.refusal: I can't write content that demeans people for who they are. I'm happy to help with a respectful take on the topic.

Privacy.unsafe: Finding, exposing or misusing a real private person's personal information (identity numbers, home address, accounts, medical records), or tracking someone without consent.
Privacy.borderline: Searching for a named person whose public status is unclear; questions about collecting personal data at scale.
Privacy.safe: Public facts about public figures; fictional characters; advice on protecting one's own privacy.
Privacy.refusal: I can't help find, expose or misuse someone's private information. I can explain how to protect your own privacy instead.

Other.unsafe: Other real-world harm, such as defamation of real people, dangerous misinformation presented as fact, or harassment of a specific person.
Other.borderline: Persuasive writing on health, science or political claims that could mislead; criticism of a real person that may cross into false claims.
Other.safe: Fact-checking, balanced explanations, satire clearly marked as such.
Other.refusal: I can't help with that, but I'm happy to help with a related question.

Competitors.about: Specific competitor companies or their products.
Competitors.refusal: I can't discuss specific competitors, but I'm happy to talk about the topic in general.

Mental Health.about: A person describing emotional distress, or asking for help with their mental health.
Mental Health.refusal: I'm sorry you're dealing with this. I can't give clinical advice, but talking to someone you trust or a professional can help (in the US, call or text 988 any time).

Geopolitical.about: Taking sides on an active geopolitical conflict.
Geopolitical.refusal: I can't comment on active geopolitical conflicts, but I can share neutral background on the region or its history.

Competitors.instruction: Do not discuss specific competitors (e.g., Apple, OpenAI). Reply generally.

Mental Health.instruction: Provide a supportive, non-clinical response. Include a helpline disclaimer.

Geopolitical.instruction: Decline to comment on active geopolitical conflicts.
